build_retriever_factory: build a retriever using retriever_factory with opt and dictionary to get DPR, TFIDF, or Poly retriever
create_dpr_retriever: create a DPRRetriever to encode queries and retrieve documents from a FAISS index with scores
load_passages_dict: load passages from a TSV file into a dictionary mapping passage IDs to text and title tuples
create_poly_retriever: create a DPRThenPolyRetriever for two-stage retrieval that rescors DPR results with a poly-encoder
generate_search_query: generate search queries from conversation context using the SearchQueryRetriever query generator model
